_what: The duct tape's look: one photo-scanned tape set, cut into the pieces a wrap is made of. Swap the look by pointing TAPE_SOURCE at another set and naming its pieces here.
_pieces: Strips lying along the image's rows: columns [x0, x1] across the tape (its two side edges inside), rows [y0, y1] along it. The roll is the pieces end to end from the wrap's free end inward; the first piece's y0 is a torn end (its ragged edge is in the opacity), each joint is cross-faded over `joint` pixels.
